findings.description: Per-call Gemini async clients were not closed.
findings.resolution: Close client.aio in finally without allowing close-only failures to discard an accepted provider result.

findings.description: batch_config returned a shallow copy with shared nested execution settings.
findings.resolution: Copy the nested execution mapping before returning configuration.

findings.description: Result-handler exceptions could preserve partial ORM mutations or poison the polling session.
findings.resolution: Run each handler application in a nested transaction and roll back only that request on failure.

findings.description: Fallback attempts were not durable before the external synchronous call.
findings.resolution: Commit the bounded attempt before calling the fallback and isolate downstream writes in a savepoint.

findings.description: Credential screening ignored structured request contents.
findings.resolution: Recursively validate the full payload before storing it.

findings.description: The read-only batch status command omitted required recent-job details.
findings.resolution: Return a bounded newest-ten list in JSON-safe human and JSON output.

findings.description: The submit sweep materialized every pending request before applying its provider-batch limit.
findings.resolution: Aggregate group readiness in SQL and load only the bounded rows selected for each ripe group.
